title: Redtale
body:
**卡包与物品绑定**

**卡包系统：**  
多种稀有度卡包（普通 / 稀有 / 传说），右键方块顶面打开。  
处于创造模式的管理员可以编辑卡包内物品。  
抽取模式：支持 ALL（全部给予）、RANDOM（随机抽取）、CHOOSE（自选）三种模式。  
_* 模组不自带修改抽取模式的 GUI，可使用 IBE Editor 等外部 Mod 方便地编辑卡包数据。_


**物品绑定：**  
物品绑定后，他人无法使用或移出容器。（可在`redtale/config.json` 中更改）  
OP 玩家不受影响。  
   
**需要[Architectury API](https://modrinth.com/mod/architectury-api)、[GeckoLib](https://modrinth.com/mod/geckolib)**  
  
**Card Pack & Item Binding**

**GachaPack System:**  
Multiple rarities of card packs (Common / Rare / Legendary), open by right-clicking on the top face of a block.  
Administrators in Creative mode can edit the items inside a card pack.  
Drawing modes: Supports ALL (give all), RANDOM (random draw), and CHOOSE (choose yourself) three modes.  
_* The mod does not include a GUI for modifying the drawing mode; you can conveniently edit card pack data using external mods like IBE Editor._

**Item Binding:**  
Once bound, other players cannot use the item or remove it from containers. (Configurable in `redtale/config.json`)  
OP players are unaffected.
   
**Requires [Architectury API](https://modrinth.com/mod/architectury-api), [GeckoLib](https://modrinth.com/mod/geckolib).**
